title_zh: 约定修订诗歌朗读介绍中的情感概括

scenario.label_zh: 约定修订诗歌朗读介绍中的情感概括
scenario.goal_zh: 根据诗句区分仇恨与复杂回忆，并商定更贴合文本的朗读介绍

context_zh: 朗读会的两位参与者讨论一首虚构诗，诗中叙述者回忆与兄弟的争执及共同生活。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: Your introduction says the speaker feels nothing but hatred toward his brother.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I took that from the line about their last argument continuing to haunt him.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: But later he remembers their childhood with affection. Being troubled by a memory is not the same as hating someone.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: You are right. I will introduce it as a poem about anger mixed with affection and regret.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: That gives the audience room to hear the different feelings in the poem.
